data.name: UNSPELLED
data.detailed_description:
YOUR NAME IS YOUR LIFE!

Most games give you a health bar. In UNSPELLED, your health is something much more personal—your name.

✂ ABOUT THIS GAME

UNSPELLED is a chaotic multiplayer party game where scissors are your weapon, your 7-letter name is your health bar, and every match turns into unforgettable chaos.

Slice off your opponents' limbs, cut away the letters of their names, steal their body parts before they can recover, and outplay everyone until you're the last name standing.

No health bars. No hit points.

Just scissors, names, and absolute mayhem.

Warning: Trust no one. Even your own limbs aren't safe.

✂ YOUR NAME IS YOUR HEALTH

Every player begins with a 7-letter name floating above their character.

Each letter represents one life.

Cut a letter away, and they lose a life.

Lose every letter, and you're Unspelled.

Example:

UNSPELL → NSPELL → SPELL → PELL → ELL → LL → L → Ghost

Simple to understand.

Terrifying when it's your name disappearing.

✂ LIMBS ARE MORE THAN COSMETIC

Every limb matters.

Cut off an opponent's leg to slow them down.

Cut off both arms and their scissor energy recovers much more slowly.

Detached limbs don't disappear—they stay in the world.

Carry them away.

Hide them.

Force your opponent to search for what's missing before they're back at full strength.

Every fight becomes a battle of positioning, timing, and sabotage.

✂ DEATH ISN'T THE END

Losing all seven letters doesn't mean you're finished.

You return as a Ghost.

Ghosts can temporarily possess detached limbs, dragging them away from living players or disrupting carefully planned strategies.

You may not be able to win anymore...

…but you can still create absolute chaos.

✂ FEATURES

• A completely unique name-as-health combat system

• Fast-paced multiplayer party battles

• Cut off limbs to weaken opponents

• Steal and hide detached body parts

• Dynamic matches where every decision matters

• Ghost gameplay after elimination

• The ever-shrinking Eraser zone keeps every match exciting

• Multiple maps with unique layouts and gameplay opportunities

• Play with friends or challenge players online

• AI Bots for solo play.

✂ FROM THE DEVELOPER

"UNSPELLED began with one simple idea: What if your name was your health bar? Everything else—the scissors, the missing limbs, the Ghosts, and the Eraser—grew from that single question. The goal is to create the kind of multiplayer game where every match leaves players with a story they'll want to tell their friends."

— Zync Studios

✂ Last Name Standing Wins. ✂

data.short_description: Cut limbs. Cut names. Be the last one standing. In this chaotic multiplayer brawler, every letter of your name is a life. Lose them all, and you're UNSPELLED.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Hindi

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Internet connection required for online multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Internet connection required for online multiplayer.
